messages.label: ERROR: cannot execute … on a read-only disaster-recovery replica
SELECT, no restore point reached yet
ERROR: no restore point to serve from (checked per node)

cards.title: One frozen image per node
items: The QD ships no snapshot — each QE fills from its own served slot, frozen at the same named point
The restore point is the cross-node agreement a distributed snapshot would otherwise provide
The visibility-map bypass is closed: index-only scans cannot leak rows newer than the cut

cards.title: Standby dispatch plumbing
items: The QD runs as DTX_CONTEXT_QD_STANDBY_READER: no gxid, no distributed snapshot
IS_HOT_STANDBY_QD() picks the standby entry per content — on a DR cluster, the only 'p' row
IS_STANDBY_QE() exemptions keep coordinator ∪ segment plans working on a writer gang

cards.title: What is refused
items: Anything but plain SELECT: rowmarks, modifying CTEs, CTAS, REFRESH — stricter than stock hot standby
DTM backstop: 'cannot start a distributed transaction on a read-only disaster-recovery replica'
gp_role=utility is not a data path: without dispatch a distributed table looks empty at any cut
